text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Loves Only You to win it for 
Japan!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAHHH~~~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun! ————"Love me♡"!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan! ――"Love me♡"!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's Loves Only You♡ Thank you so much, 
everyone~~!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
A Japanese Umamusume winning the Breeders' 
Cup—what an incredible achievement! Loves 
Only You-san!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
You were making a heart pose with your 
Trainer after the victory, weren't you! Is 
that your signature pose together?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right♪ I'm thinking of 
spreading the word from now on♡

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
All eyes are already on the outcome of 
America's Horse of the Year honors, the 
Eclipse Awards!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
There are high hopes that you could become 
the first Japanese Umamusume in history to 
win this award, Loves Only You-san! How do 
you feel about that!?
choice_data_list:
She was amazing today! That's what matters 
most!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Everyone! I won!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Uoooooh!" "We saw it!" "What an 
achievement!" "That little Loves-chan is 
now...!" "Loves-chan! You're the best!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... I'm truly so happy. To be able 
to show this view to everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though brief due to low battery, I managed 
to stream directly to my community members 
to report my victory—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Pheeew... That was quite the whirlwind...
choice_data_list:
Let's take a breather while we have the 
chance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although we finished handling various 
matters, the evening is packed with 
interviews and victory parties. I had 
hoped to let her rest first, but...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-kun. Want to step outside 
for a little bit?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-chan. Want to step outside 
for a little bit?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Ah! Hey, Trainer-kun, look at that.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Ah! Hey, Trainer-chan, look at that.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. It's the same ice cream shop as 
last year. I ended up ordering the exact 
same flavor, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last year, I was completely desperate. 
Desperate to reach the stage of the BC, 
and to make her win. She saw right through 
that overeagerness—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She offered me this ice cream. It had a 
comforting sweetness, as if bringing our 
hearts just a little closer.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's strange... It's the same flavor, but 
it tastes so much sweeter and more 
delicious than last year. —Just like you 
and me, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's strange... It's the same flavor, but 
it tastes so much sweeter and more 
delicious than last year. —Just like you 
and me, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-kun. There's something I'd 
like to consult you about.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-chan. There's something 
I'd like to consult you about.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—What kind of world do you want to go see 
next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You gazes straight at me. The 
scenery I just witnessed— her first BC 
victory—revives behind my eyelids.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being able to see that scenery together. 
Sharing that emotion with the 
commu-members and fans around the world. 
The frenzy, the love—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to spread more and more love like 
that, to share it. I know—we both feel the 
exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Across the sea, there are still so 
many different worlds out there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the vast ocean, toward a world 
yet unseen―― If it's Loves Only You... If 
it's the two of us, we can fly out 
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. You already know where we're 
going next, don't you? Let's say it 
together on three. ...Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan. You already know where we're 
going next, right? Let's say it on three, 
okay? ...One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: "—Hong Kong!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. Let's spread lots and lots of 
love together. —Right, "Love Me♡"?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: It's a promise, okay? ♡
